VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__Meta.Description: The Vale roof glaze bar as built: a cap, a core and a trim sharing one section datum. Cap and core are fixed; only the trim depth is configurable.
VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__Meta.SectionFrameNote: All parts are authored in one shared section frame taken from Na__Asset__Plan2D__Top. Section +x runs across the bar, section +y runs out through the roof, and section 0,0 is the glaze bar datum. The parts assemble with no fitting and their solid areas do not overlap.
VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__Meta.OverallWidthNote: The widest point across the assembled bar, which is the cap. Consumed by the 2D profile trace overlay, where a bar is drawn as a band of its real width.
VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__Meta.HandAuthoredNote: Written by hand rather than generated. This is a fixed three part system, not a catalogue: a build utility scanning a folder could not know which asset fills which slot.
VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__Meta.AssetResolutionNote: Parts name an AssetId and nothing else. The file behind an id is resolved through VghLantern__AssetRegistry__.json, which is the one place a path is written down. This index carried a LibraryRoot and a JsonUrl per part until 21-Aug-2026, when the folder was renamed 45_1000__GlazeBars to 45_2000__GlazeBars__Profiles and every one of them pointed at a file that no longer existed, with nothing to report it.
VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__Meta.ProductCodeNote: Renumbered 45_10xx to 45_20xx on 21-Aug-2026. The x_1xxx block is the component library and the x_2xxx block is the profile library, matching the ridge and hip systems, so a code now says which library holds it. TrimOptionId is a product code and moved with them; ProjectSchemaValidator migrates the stored value on load.

VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__Parts.WebHalfWidthAtGlassNote: Half the upright web of the core where it stands between two panes. The web runs x -2.5 to +2.5 from section y 5 (the top of the 39mm glazing leg) to 45.7, through the whole glass band (8 to 36). MEASURED from this asset's Plan2D__Top with the app's own SectionLoopBuilder on 20-Oct-2026, the way the extents above were; measure it again if the core is re-exported. The glazing panel layout stops every pane GlazingInterface EdgeClearanceMm off this web, so a pane edge sits 5.5mm off the bar centreline, under the cap.
VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__Parts.Note: Always present. The structural extrusion every other part hangs off.

Always present. Powder coated, but finished in its own right rather than following the lantern frame: the frame is painted joinery and the outside of the roof is dressed in lead flashing, so the frame colour has no bearing on the capping above it. The choice is stored per lantern as Lantern__GlazingBars__Config__CapFinish.
Always present, but the depth is the one glaze bar choice the user makes.

Preview2d.PreviewNote: The whole assembled bar, not the trim alone, so the depth choice reads against the cap and core it sits under.

VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__EndCapRelati.RotationDegreesNote: THREE ANGLES IN DEGREES, about the asset's OWN X, Y and Z. Edit these until it looks right; nothing else needs touching. At 0, 0, 0 the part sits exactly as authored in SketchUp.
VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__EndCapRelati.RotationOrderNote: Applied LocalX, then LocalY, then LocalZ, each about the asset's axes IN THEIR REST POSITION rather than about wherever the previous turn left them. That is what makes them nudgeable: one number always means the same thing however the other two are set. Try 90, -90 and 180 first.
VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__EndCapRelati.EndCapNote: The cast cap that closes the cut end of the glaze bar cap at the eaves, welded to 45_2021. Without it the bare extrusion section is left on show at the bottom of every bar.
VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__EndCapRelati.SeatSectionYNote: The seating height in the shared section frame, measured along Up from the bar datum. 36.908 is the BASE of the cap section that 45_2021 declares as its SectionMinYMm. If the cap sits proud or buried, this is the number to move - it and LocalAxisMap are the two knobs, and neither needs a code change.
VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__EndCapRelati.AlongBarOffsetNote: Signed along the bar, positive further out towards the eaves. Zero puts the cap's outer face exactly where the glaze bar cap extrusion now ends. It is declared rather than assumed so a measured weld gap is one number in this file rather than an edit to a mesh builder.
VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__EndCapRelati.ElementTypeNote: Trim and Decoration, identical to the cap it terminates. Decoration is the drawing office word and sits in ElementRole; ElementType stays inside the five word vocabulary the 3D isolation and the specification tables filter on.
VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__EndCapRelati.SpecFinishNote: Powder coated. Follows the glaze bar cap finish, so cap and end cap move together when a lantern diverges the cap to White Painted or Lead.
VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__EndCapRelati.PlacementNote: One at the eaves end of every bar that HAS an eaves end. A bar running ridge to hip has none and takes no cap, which the layout already answers with EavesEnd null.
VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__EndCapRelati.RotationRestFrameNote: At rest the asset's X runs down the bar towards the eaves, its Y runs across the bar, and its Z runs out through the roof square to the slope. So LocalX rolls it, LocalY tips it nose over tail, and LocalZ spins it flat on the roof plane.

VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__GlazingInter.Description: How the glass sits on the bar, and the numbers every glazing panel is cut with. Read by VghLantern__Geometry__GlazingPanelLayout, which publishes them on its panel set so the 3D view, the projected drawings and the SketchUp export lift one glass by one set of numbers. Added 20-Oct-2026 (v0.9.0), when the glass was divided into panels between the bars and hips.
VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__GlazingInter.BeddingOffsetNote: The unit's inner face above the glaze bar datum: the 5mm glazing leg of the core 45_2011 (section y 0 to 5) plus 3mm of setting tape. Lived in a JS fallback table in Env3d ConfigAccess and in the SketchUp export config until v0.9.0; both copies are now only read when this index cannot be.
VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__GlazingInter.UnitThicknessNote: The sealed unit modelled as one mass, measured outward from the bedding face: its outer face at 36mm above the datum, just under the cap skirts at 36.908 (the cap 45_2021's SectionMinYMm). Adam, 20-Oct-2026: 'for now we will morph with single masses like now'; the separate skins, spacer and edge seal come later.
VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__GlazingInter.EdgeClearanceNote: Adam, 20-Oct-2026: 'use a 3mm each side tolerance so you have | Rafter | 3mm | Glazing | 3mm | Rafter |'. Measured from the upright web of the member the glass stops against (the glaze bar, hip and ridge cores, and the eaves extrusion upstand), along the glass and square to the panel edge. Adam chose the web over the outside of the cap: the glass beds on the core's glazing leg and is held under the cap.
VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__GlazingInter.OuterPaneOversailsNote: The stepped eaves edge (Adam's section sketch, 20-Oct-2026: 'the top pane of glass oversails the eaves trim'). The unit at full thickness stops EdgeClearanceMm short of the eaves extrusion upstand (the base frame index's GlassStopAlongPitchMm); only the top pane runs on over it to the glaze bar cap ends. false stops the whole unit at the upstand.
VghLantern__GlazeBarSystem__GlazingInter.OuterPaneThicknessNote: PROVISIONAL. The oversailing top pane's thickness, agreed with Adam on 20-Oct-2026 as a stand-in until his glazing panel design diagram gives the real build-up. It is the top 6mm of the 28mm unit, so the lip sits 30 to 36mm above the datum, clear of the upstand fins at 25.365. Change it here; nothing else holds it.
